Vulnerability handling (CRA Annex I Part II)
Are vulnerabilities and components contained in the product identified and documented?
Is a software bill of materials (SBOM) maintained in a commonly used, machine-readable format covering at least the top-level dependencies?
Are vulnerabilities addressed and remediated without delay, including by providing security updates?

Are effective and regular tests and reviews of the product security applied?

Yes.label: Testing cadence

elements.text: Once a security update is available, is information about the fixed vulnerabilities shared and publicly disclosed (description, affected products, impact, severity, remediation)?
Is a policy on coordinated vulnerability disclosure in place, enforced and published?
Is a contact address for reporting vulnerabilities (including in third-party components) provided and published?
Are updates distributed through a secure mechanism that protects their integrity and authenticity?
Where applicable, are security updates installed in an automatic manner (with user notification)?
Are security updates disseminated without delay and free of charge, accompanied by advisory messages?
